title: Live capture — 2026-11-14 desk refresh
captured_at_et: 2026-11-13 20:37 to 20:55 (ET). NBA league day is still Friday 13 November; the Nov 13 slate was in progress at capture (see results_2026_11_13_in_progress.json).
method: Each file in this directory is a transcription of one official NBA property page or league PDF, fetched through the agent's page reader. The sandbox itself has no general outbound network (curl to nba.com returns 000), so every figure below carries the URL it was read from and the minute it was read.

sources.what: NBA.com Games & Scores, slate of 2026-11-14 (also used for the Nov 13, Nov 15 and Nov 16 slates and for the month calendar of game counts)
NBA.com Stats, Teams Advanced, 2026-27 Regular Season (all 30 rows)
Official NBA Injury Report, games of 11/13 and 11/14, 07:30 PM ET edition (league PDF)
Official NBA injury-report hub (report index + submission rules)
sources.note: At read time the newest published edition was 'November 13: 7:30 p.m ET report'. No 11/14 game-day edition existed yet.

sources.what: NBA.com box score page for game 0022600230 (CHA@PHX, 11/12) — used to spot-check the archived final scores the backtest is built on
NBA.com live scoreboard for the 11/13 slate (in-progress scores at capture)
NBA.com Stats, Teams Advanced, date-filtered to the FIT window 10/20/2026–11/05/2026 (30 rows) — the ratings behind every graded prediction
sources.note: Establishes that an official point-in-time window is obtainable, which is what makes a clean out-of-sample test possible. The earlier 14-game backtest in scripts/backtest.py is contaminated precisely because nobody had checked this.

sources.what: NBA.com player game log — Nikola Jokić (profile + 'Last 5 Games')
NBA.com player game log — LaMelo Ball (profile + 'Last 5 Games')
NBA.com player game log — Giannis Antetokounmpo (profile + 'Last 5 Games')
sources.url_verification: copied verbatim from data/live/player_game_logs.json, which is the record of the page that was actually read. The numeric player id in an NBA.com URL is not derived or corrected here: if it differs from another source, both are printed and neither is silently fixed.

sources.what: NBA.com Games & Scores, slate of 2026-11-12 — the four finals the backtest's last day rests on
NBA.com play-by-play page for game 0022600230 (quarter timestamps; used to test whether game-flow data is reachable at all)
sources.note: Readable from chunk 1 onward; chunk 0 is the global scoreboard module. Not used in any published number on this desk.

sources.what: NBA.com Schedule page (Week 4 strip: all nine 11/13 finals with scores and status labels; 11/14-17 cards with tip times, venues and post-11/13 records)
sources.note: Session arena/df3fed12-nba1. Independent re-read; produced results_2026_11_13_final.json and slate_records_reread_2026_11_14.json.

sources.what: The nine 2026-11-13 game pages (summary headers) — nyk-vs-ind, mil-vs-orl, cle-vs-mia, atl-vs-chi, mem-vs-nop, por-vs-sac plus abbreviated renders of uta-vs-hou, gsw-vs-sas, okc-vs-lac
sources.note: Six games printed the final score on the game's own summary header. UTA@HOU returned an abbreviated render twice (score not repeated); GSW@SAS and OKC@LAC repeated the score in the scoreboard block on their own box-score URLs. Verification level recorded per game.
Period selector prints Q1-Q4 and OT1 only: exactly one overtime, so ot=1 for 0022600037 (the prior session left it null as unconfirmed).

sources.what: NBA official injury-report index (edition list) and the 11/14 05:00 AM ET PDF; 05:15 AM ET probed
sources.note: Index listed 11/14 editions 12:00 AM-05:00 AM ET; Injury-Report_2026-11-14_05_15AM.pdf returned AccessDenied (not published), so 05:00 AM is the newest. Captured as injury_report_2026_11_14_0500AM.json.

sources.what: NBA.com Stats > Teams Advanced with Date To 11/13/2026 (30-row table)
sources.note: Captured as team_windows_live_2026_11_13.json. gp == w + l for all 30; W-L agrees with the schedule-card reread for all 30 clubs.

not_obtained: Any sportsbook price: no odds feed is reachable from this sandbox and no official NBA property publishes one. Consequence: closing-line value, break-even and ROI cannot be computed, so no market gate can be passed. This is stated on every page that would otherwise show a number.

Final scores for the 11/13 slate: OBTAINED 2026-11-14 ~10:35Z by session arena/df3fed12-nba1 — see results_2026_11_13_final.json (nine games, official pages). This line kept for the history of the original capture.

Player game logs: OBTAINED IN PART since this register was first written. The official per-game log page is readable one player at a time, and 12 rows across 3 players are transcribed in player_game_logs.json. Still absent: logs for the other 462 players on the captured season page, which is what a slate-wide prop table needs.
Injury designations for the 11/15 and 11/16 slates: under the league rule the day-before deadline is 5 p.m. local the day before the game, so those rows did not exist at capture.

amendments.what: Added sources L9–L14 (the second, later part of the same capture session), corrected the game-log entry in not_obtained, and fixed captured_at_utc, which stopped at 00:55 while the logs were read until 01:05. Also corrected a stale filename reference: this file pointed at results_2026_11_13_partial.json while the file actually written is results_2026_11_13_in_progress.json.

Added sources L15-L19 (session arena/df3fed12-nba1, COORDINATION §21 D02): the 11/13 finals re-read, the 11/14 05:00 AM ET injury edition, and the LIVE ratings window through 11/13. New files: results_2026_11_13_final.json, injury_report_2026_11_14_0500AM.json, team_windows_live_2026_11_13.json, slate_records_reread_2026_11_14.json. No file in this directory was overwritten; the earlier captures remain as provenance.

host_note: Sandbox egress is limited to github.com, npmjs and pypi; curl to nba.com returns HTTP 000. Every value in this directory therefore came through the agent's page reader, and only the URL is citable — not a reproducible HTTP fetch.
